t: Din arba ammot sheyyesh lekol adam beshabbat
s: Din arba ammot sheyyesh lekol adam beshabbat ubo d' seipim: "shebu ish tachtayv al yetze ish mimmeqomo bayyom hashshebii". Yesh omerim shezzo azhara leyotze chutz lattechum, veshiur techum shel tora hu y"b mil, keshiur machaneh yisrael shehayeta y"b mil al y"b mil. Vachakamim aseru latzet yoter mealpayim ammot, shehen mil a'. Veyesh omerim sheen litchumin iqqar min hattora kelal, ella apillu yoter mi"b mil eno asur min hattora kelal. Vezeh shenneemar "al yetze ish mimmeqomo" — zo hi azhara al hotzaa, shehizhir mosheh shello latzet im hakkeli mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim lilqot hamman. U"shebu ish tachtayv" — qibbelu chakamim shezzo azhara shello letaltel birshut harabbim ella keshiur tachtayv shel adam, shehu d' ammot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"t. Ella shechakamim sameku issur hattechumin shel dibrehem lemiqra zeh "al yetze ish mimmeqomo", shello yetze yoter mealpayim mehammaqom sheshshabat bo, ki ad alpayim niqra meqomo, kemo shemmatzinu beare miqlat, shenneemar "vesamti leka maqom vego'", vehen qoletot oto gam keshehu chutza lahen, shenneemar "umatza oto michutz ligbul ir miqlato", veneemar lehallan "umaddotem michutz lair et peat qedema alpayim baamma vego'". Mah "chutz" haamur lehallan — alpayim, ap "chutz" haamur kan — alpayim. U"shebu ish tachtayv" — keshiur tachtayv. Mikkan sameku chakamim shekkol adam yesh lo d' ammot bekol maqom shehu, apillu yatza chutz lattechum — yakol lehallek sham d' ammot, veken yakol letaltel bahen. Veken keshemmodedim alpayim mimmeqom shebitato — modedim chutz mid' ammot ellu, shehen keshiur tachtayv (veyakol letaltel bahen. Lepikak) im shabat, dehaynu sheqqiddesh alayv hayyom, bemaqom hammuqqap mechitztzot beinyan shemmuttar letaltel bekullo — hare kullo nechshab lo ked' ammot, venotenim lo alpayim sabib leheqqep zeh, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"t, apillu yesh bo kamma milin. Vehu sheyyehe muqqap ledirato mittechillato, ap al pi sheen bo atta diyyurin veen mishtammeshin bo kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"ch, o apillu eno muqqap ledira ella sheen bo yoter mibbet satayim. Abal im yesh bo yoter mibbet satayim — keshem sheen mechitztzoteha moilot sheyyehe muttar letaltel bekullo, kak enan moilot sheyyehe kullo nechshab ked' ammot leinyan techumin:

D' ammot ellu shelleinyan techumin — ben d' ammot shebbimqom shebitato, ben d' ammot sheyyesh lo kesheyyatza chutz lattechum — yesh omerim shehen ked' ammot shebbirshut harabbim shelleinyan tiltul, shehu borer lo d' ammot leezo ruach sheyyirtzeh, ukeshehalak leruach achat d' ammot — shub eno yakol lachazor velelek leruach hashshenit (shekkenegdah) apillu kol shehu im hu chutz lattechum, kemo sheeno yakol letaltel chepetz echad yoter mid' ammot, sheen notenim alakson leinyan tiltul ella mippene sheen sham ribbua, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"t. Veken bemaqom sheshshabat bo, im halak leruach achat d' ammot vealpayim — shub eno yakol lelek leruach hashshenit (shekkenegdah) ella alpayim. Veim lo natal lo kol d' ammot leruach achat, yakol lehashliman beruach hab' (shekkenegdah). Veyesh omerim shed' ammot ellu shelleinyan techumin eno ked' ammot shelleinyan tiltul, ella hen d' ammot lekol ruach, shehen ch' al ch' merubbaot, ben bemaqom sheshshabat bo ben kesheyyatza chutz lattechum (ulepi sebara zo kol shekken sheen modedim lo d' ammot im alaksonam lekol ruach, shekkevan shennotenim lo ch' al ch' merubbaot — hare yesh bahen alakson mammash shel d' ammot lekol ruach, dehaynu meemtzaito learba hazzaviyyot. Mah sheen ken bed' ammot shelleinyan tiltul, shemmodedim lo d' ammot beyosher el eber panayv leezo ruach sheyyirtzeh, vekevan shello shayyak bahen alakson mammash — tzarik litten lo hen vaalaksonam, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"t). Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim:

D' ammot ellu shellekol ruach veruach, shehen shiur tachtayv shel adam — modedim oto lekol adam beamma shello. Veim hu nannas beebarim, sheggupo gadol veammato qetanna — notenim lo d' ammot benonit shel kol adam, shekkol achat mehen v' tepachim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"t. Ukebar nitbaer sham shed' ammot ellu modedim otan metzumtzamot. Veyesh omerim shemmodedim otan meruvvachot, veyesh lismok al dibrehem bed' ammot ellu shelleinyan techumin, sheiqqaran enan ella middibre soperim:

Shabat betel gaboah y' tepachim, im en bo ella bet satayim — hare kullo nechshab lo ked' ammot, mippene shehu kemuqqap mechitztzot milmala, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h, ella sheenan muqqapot ledira. Veken im shabat beqama qetzura veshibbolim gebohim y' tepachim maqqipim otah. Vehu sheqqashar hashshibbolim yachad beinyan sheen ruach hammetzuya menida otan, shekkol mechitztza sheharuach menidah — enah mechitztza, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b. Abal hashshobet beir — kol hair nechshebet ked' ammot, ap al pi sheenah muqqepet mechitztzot kehilkatan, kegon sheyyesh bah peratzot harbeh bemilluan ubeyoter meeser, dehoil ubatte hair mublaim betok shibim amma veshirayim shel zeh — hare kullam kedira achat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"ch:
